method.renderer: content/tools/render_listen.cpp: firmware app/*.cpp, audio/*.cpp, fx/*.cpp and the fork DSP built in double on the host, wavetable banks through audio::WaveStore from content/data/wtp
method.load: as BROWSE: applyPresetFx, applyPresetIndex, voices = presetVoices then fitVoicesToBudget; project defaults (master 100); the dry twin has the same voices, every send 0 and the amp OFF
method.level: one gain per preset, set from the DRY twin: its active-region RMS (mono sum, frames above -30 dB of the loudest) to -20 dBFS, peak at most 0.89 over BOTH renders; the WITH EFFECTS file uses the same gain
method.figures: addedDb: whole-render energy with effects against dry (dB); diffDb: energy of (with effects - dry) against dry (dB; the effect layer); tailFx/DryDb: RMS dBFS from last note-off + 0.5 s to the end at the shared gain; tail60S: seconds after the last note-off until the 50 ms RMS stays under -60 dBFS
method.notesSilent: notes of the phrase whose first 60 ms are silent in the dry render (a dropped note)
